inputs.prompt: Edit this drone image. Change only the camera at the nose: remove the dark window strip embedded in the nose and add a small gimbal camera that hangs underneath the front of the fuselage, as on modern foldable camera drones. Seen from directly above, only the top edge of the small dark grey camera housing peeks out just ahead of the nose; the lens faces straight forward toward the top edge of the image, so no lens glass is visible from above. Keep everything else exactly the same: the strict orthographic top view, the body outline, the top cover panels and parting lines, the seamless arms, the motors with their orange rings, the two-blade propellers and their angles, the colours and the plain light background.
inputs.negative_prompt: flat schematic, line drawing, collage, text, labels, logo, cropped rotor, disconnected arm, extra rotor, perspective camera, camera lens visible from above, upward-facing lens, camera on a neck or stalk, camera on a post, camera at the tail, dark module at the tail, V-shaped propeller, blades at an acute angle, single-blade propeller, missing blade, unequal blades
